chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Salih ibn Uqba who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'I saw your garden, so have you planted anything in it afterwards?' I said, 'I intended to take stems from your garden (and plant these)'. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Shall I inform you with what is better for you than it and quicker?' I said, 'Yes'. He (peace be upon him) said: 'When dates ripen and you are about to pick them as fresh dates, plant them, it (the crop) will produce just like what you planted. So I did that and it grew as the same like it'.

key_terms.تُرْطِبَ: To become rutab (fresh, soft dates just before full ripeness)
key_terms.حَائِط: Garden or enclosed plot of land
key_terms.غَرَسَ: To plant (specifically grafting or planting a stem/fruit)
key_terms.وَدِيّاً: Stems or cuttings taken from a tree for propagation

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method for planting date palms according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) guides Salih ibn Uqba on the optimal agricultural practice of planting date palms when the fruit transitions from ripe (busrah) to fresh (rutab), promising a yield equal to the original planting. This advice reflects the practical agricultural knowledge of the time, emphasizing the importance of timing in propagation to ensure prosperity and abundance, which serves as a metaphor for spiritual cultivation in Shia tradition.

en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘I saw your garden, have you planted anything in it yet?’ I said, ‘I wanted to take small stems from your garden and plant them.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Allow me to tell you what is better than this and quicker.’ I replied, ‘Yes please do so.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘When dates ripen and you are about to pick them as fresh dates, plant them, it (the crop) will produce just like what you planted.’ I followed the instruction and it (the crop) grew exactly like it.’”
